question: What is VAT?
answer: An indirect tax on consumption, charged on value added to goods and services at each stage; applies to taxable supplies by a taxable person, imports (non-exempt), and imported services (non-exempt).
answer_lg: Omusolo ogutali gwa butereevu oguggyibwa ku nkozesa y'ebintu n'obuweereza ku buli mutendera; gukozesebwa ku bintu n'obuweereza ebisasulwako omusolo eby'omuntu alina okusasula omusolo, ebiyingizibwa mu ggwanga (ebitasonyiyiddwa), n'obuweereza obuyingizibwa okuva ebweru.
answer_sw: Kodi isiyo ya moja kwa moja ya matumizi, inayotozwa kwa thamani iliyoongezwa kwenye bidhaa na huduma katika kila hatua; inatumika kwa bidhaa na huduma zinazotozwa kodi na mtu anayepaswa kulipa kodi, uagizaji kutoka nje (usiotozwa msamaha), na huduma kutoka nje.

question: What are taxable, standard-rated, zero-rated, and exempt supplies?
answer: Taxable supplies are non-exempt supplies made for consideration. Standard-rated attract 18%; zero-rated attract 0% (e.g., exports, locally made drugs/medicines, and cereals grown and milled in Uganda). Exempt supplies (Third Schedule of the VAT Act) have no VAT and include health/life insurance, educational services, unprocessed foodstuffs and agricultural products, and passenger transport (other than tour operators).
question_lg: Emirimu ki egisasulwako omusolo, egy'omuwendo ogwa bulijjo, egya 0%, n'egisonyiyiddwa?
answer_lg: Emirimu egisasulwako omusolo gye mirimu egitasasulwako musolo gwa VAT nga gikolebwa olw'ensimbi. Omuwendo ogwa bulijjo guli 18%; ogwa 0% gukozesebwa ku bintu ebifulumizibwa ebweru, eddagala erikolebwa mu Uganda, n'emmere ey'obulimi ebirimibwa mu Uganda. Ebintu ebisonyiyiddwa (Third Schedule eya VAT Act) tebiriiko VAT era birimu inshuwa ya bulamu, ebyenjigiriza, emmere etateguddwa n'ebintu by'obulimi, n'entambula y'abasaabaze.
question_sw: Ni bidhaa zipi zinazotozwa kodi, kiwango cha kawaida, asilimia sifuri, na zilizosamehewa?
answer_sw: Bidhaa zinazotozwa kodi ni bidhaa zisizosamehewa zinazotolewa kwa malipo. Kiwango cha kawaida ni 18%; kiwango cha sifuri ni 0% (kama bidhaa zinazouzwa nje, dawa zinazotengenezwa Uganda, na nafaka zinazolimwa Uganda). Bidhaa zilizosamehewa (Jedwali la Tatu la Sheria ya VAT) hazina VAT na zinajumuisha bima ya afya/maisha, huduma za elimu, vyakula ambavyo havijasindikwa na mazao ya kilimo, na usafiri wa abiria.

question: Who must register for VAT?
answer: Anyone making taxable supplies whose turnover exceeds or is expected to exceed UGX 75,000,000 in any three (3) consecutive calendar months (one quarter) or UGX 300,000,000 in any twelve (12) month period. Public authorities carrying on business must register regardless of turnover.
answer_lg: Omuntu yenna akola emirimu egisasulwako omusolo nga ssente z'atunda zisukka oba zisuubirwa okusukka UGX 75,000,000 mu myezi esatu (3) egy'omuddiringanwa (ekitundu kimu) oba UGX 300,000,000 mu bbanga ly'emyezi kkumi n'ebiri (12). Ebitongole bya gavumenti ebikola bizinensi birina okwewandiisa wadde nga tebinnatuuka ku kkomo eyo.
answer_sw: Mtu yeyote anayetoa bidhaa au huduma zinazotozwa kodi ambaye mauzo yake yanazidi au yanatarajiwa kuzidi UGX 75,000,000 katika miezi mitatu (3) mfululizo ya kalenda (robo moja) au UGX 300,000,000 katika kipindi cha miezi kumi na mbili (12). Mamlaka za umma zinazofanya biashara lazima zijisajili bila kujali mauzo.

question: Can I register voluntarily?
answer: Yes. A business whose sales do not exceed UGX 75,000,000 for three consecutive calendar months may apply for voluntary registration if it has a fixed place of business, proper records, and is a fit-and-proper person, subject to the Commissioner General's discretion.
answer_lg: Yee. Bizinensi etasukka kutunda UGX 75,000,000 mu myezi esatu egy'omuddiringanwa esobola okusaba okwewandiisa ku bwayo singa erina ekifo ky'omulimu ekitebenkedde, ebiwandiiko ebituufu, n'obwesigwa obulungi, okusinziira ku kusalawo kw'Omukulu w'Ekitongole (Commissioner General).
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Biashara ambayo mauzo yake hayazidi UGX 75,000,000 kwa miezi mitatu mfululizo ya kalenda inaweza kuomba usajili wa hiari ikiwa ina eneo maalum la biashara, kumbukumbu sahihi, na mtu anayefaa, chini ya hiari ya Kamishna Mkuu.

question: How is VAT calculated (input vs output)?
answer: Output VAT is VAT you charge on sales; input VAT is VAT you paid on taxable purchases/imports. If output > input, pay the difference to URA; if input > output, the difference is claimable through an offset or a cash refund if the excess exceeds UGX 10,000,000.
answer_lg: Output VAT ye VAT gye musuubuzi gy'aggya ku bitundibwa; input VAT ye VAT gye yansasudde ku kugula ebintu oba okubiyingiza mu ggwanga. Singa output esukka input, sasula enjawulo eri URA; singa input esukka output, enjawulo eyo esobola okusabibwa ng'okukkirizibwa oba okuddizibwa ssente enkalu singa ezisukkiridde zisukka UGX 10,000,000.
question_sw: Jinsi gani VAT inavyokokotolewa (ingizo dhidi ya pato)?
answer_sw: VAT ya kutoa (output VAT) ni VAT unayotoza kwenye mauzo; VAT ya kuingiza (input VAT) ni VAT uliyolipa unaponunua au kuagiza bidhaa. Ikiwa pato linazidi ingizo, lipa tofauti hiyo kwa URA; ikiwa ingizo linazidi pato, tofauti hiyo inaweza kudaiwa kupitia fidia au kurejeshewa pesa taslimu ikiwa ziada inazidi UGX 10,000,000.

question: What if supply value isn’t clear?
answer: Use fair market value of the good or service at the time of supply (e.g. barter trade, gifts, or when a taxable person withdraws business goods for personal use).
question_lg: Kiki ekikolebwa singa omuwendo gw'ebitundiddwa tegumanyiddwa bulungi?
answer_lg: Kozesa omuwendo ogw'akatale ogw'ebintu oba obuweereza mu kaseera we biweereddwa (okuweebwa obulabo, okugabana ebintu, oba omusuubuzi bw'aggya ebintu ku bizinensi okubikozesa ku bwe).
question_sw: Je, ikiwa thamani ya usambazaji haiko wazi?
answer_sw: Tumia thamani halisi ya soko ya bidhaa au huduma wakati wa usambazaji (kwa mfano biashara ya kubadilishana bidhaa, zawadi, au mfanyabiashara anapochukua bidhaa za biashara kwa matumizi binafsi).

question: What are obligations after VAT registration?
answer: Charge 18% VAT and issue tax invoices; register and use EFRIS to issue e-invoices/e-receipts; file monthly VAT returns within 15 days after month-end (pre-filled via EFRIS); pay any VAT due within 15 days; maintain proper accounting records for at least 5 years.
question_lg: Buvunaanyizibwa ki obubaawo oluvannyuma lw'okwewandiisa ku VAT?
answer_lg: Ggyako omusolo gwa VAT ogwa 18% era owe invoisi z'omusolo; wewandiise era okozese EFRIS okufulumya risiti za e-invoices/e-receipts; waayo return za buli mwezi mu nnaku 15 oluvannyuma lw'omwezi okuggwako (ezijjuza nga ziyita mu EFRIS); sasula VAT yenna erina okusasulwa mu nnaku 15; kuuma ebiwandiiko by'ebitabo by'ebyenfuna okumala emyaka 5 egy'ebula.
question_sw: Je, ni majukumu yapi baada ya usajili wa VAT?
answer_sw: Toza 18% ya VAT na utoe ankara za kodi; jisajili na utumie EFRIS kutoa e-invoices/e-receipts; wasilisha ripoti za kila mwezi za VAT ndani ya siku 15 baada ya mwisho wa mwezi (zilizojazwa mapema kupitia EFRIS); lipa VAT yoyote inayodaiwa ndani ya siku 15; weka kumbukumbu sahihi za mahesabu kwa angalau miaka 5.

question: How does EFRIS relate to VAT?
answer: All VAT-registered taxpayers must issue e-invoices/e-receipts through EFRIS so every transaction is fiscalized. EFRIS automatically tracks input VAT tax credits on purchases and output VAT on sales, enabling pre-filled return submissions.
answer_lg: Abasasuzi b'omusolo bonna abawandiisiddwa ku VAT balina okufulumya e-invoices/e-receipts nga bayita mu EFRIS buli nkyukakyuka mu by'obusubuzi ekakasibwe. EFRIS ebala ku bwayo input VAT ku kugula ebintu ne output VAT ku kutunda, ekisobozesa return okujjuzaayo mangu.
question_sw: Je, EFRIS inahusiana vipi na VAT?
answer_sw: Walipakodi wote waliosajiliwa kwa VAT lazima watoe e-invoices/e-receipts kupitia EFRIS ili kila ununuzi na uuzaji uthibitishwe. EFRIS inafuatilia kiotomatiki salio la kodi ya VAT kwenye ununuzi na VAT ya mauzo, kuwezesha uwasilishaji wa ritani uliowekwa mapema.

question: What is consideration?
answer: Payment in money or kind (wholly or partly) for a taxable supply, including any duties, levies, fees, and charges paid or payable.
answer_lg: Okusasula mu nsimbi oba mu bintu olw'emirimu egisasulwako omusolo, nga mw'otwalidde n'emisolo emirala, ebisale n'okuggyako kwonna okusasuliddwa oba okuliko okusasulwa.
answer_sw: Malipo kwa njia ya pesa au bidhaa kwa ajili ya bidhaa au huduma zinazotozwa kodi, ikijumuisha ushuru wowote, ada, na tozo zilizolipwa au zinazopaswa kulipwa.

question: Who is a taxable person?
answer: Anyone registered for VAT or required to be registered (individuals, partnerships, trusts, companies, government bodies, listed institutions).
question_lg: Ani ayitibwa omuntu alina okusasula omusolo (taxable person)?
answer_lg: Omuntu yenna eyawandiisibwa ku VAT oba eyeetaagibwa okwewandiisa (abantu ssekinnoomu, ebibiina by'obusuubuzi, trusts, amakampuni, ebitongole bya gavumenti).
question_sw: Nani anayehesabika kama mtu anayepaswa kulipa kodi (taxable person)?
answer_sw: Mtu yeyote aliyesajiliwa kwa VAT au anayetakiwa kusajiliwa (watu binafsi, ushirika, trusts, makampuni, mashirika ya serikali).

question: What VAT rate applies to imports and imported services?
answer: VAT applies at 18% to imports of goods (unless exempt under the Fifth Schedule EACCMA) and to imported services deemed supplied in Uganda; the importer/receiver is liable.
question_lg: Muwendo ki ogwa VAT ogukozesebwa ku bintu n'obuweereza ebiyingizibwa mu ggwanga?
answer_lg: VAT ebalirirwa ku 18% ku bintu ebiyingizibwa mu ggwanga (ng'oggyeko ebisonyiyiddwa wansi wa Fifth Schedule eya EACCMA) ne ku buweereza obuyingizibwa mu Uganda; omuyingiza w'ebintu y'avunaanyizibwa.
question_sw: Ni kiwango gani cha VAT kinachotumika kwa bidhaa na huduma zinazoingizwa nchini?
answer_sw: VAT inatumika kwa kiwango cha 18% kwenye bidhaa zinazoingizwa nchini (isipokuwa zilizosamehewa chini ya Jedwali la Tano la EACCMA) na kwa huduma zinazoingizwa nchini Uganda; mwagizaji anawajibika.

question: When are VAT returns and payments due?
answer: Within 15 days after the end of each month for VAT-registered persons via the URA web portal.
question_lg: Return za VAT n'okusasula binafuuka ddi obudde?
answer_lg: Mu nnaku 15 oluvannyuma lw'omwezi okuggwako eri abantu abawandiisiddwa ku VAT nga bayita ku mukutu gwa URA.
question_sw: Je, ritani na malipo ya VAT yanatakiwa kuwasilishwa lini?
answer_sw: Ndani ya siku 15 baada ya mwisho wa kila mwezi kwa watu waliosajiliwa kwa VAT kupitia tovuti ya URA.

question: What happens if I deal only in exempt supplies?
answer: You are not expected or allowed to register for VAT; VAT registration applies only to persons making standard-rated or zero-rated taxable supplies.
question_lg: Kiki ekibaawo singa nkola ku bintu ebisonyiyiddwa byokka?
answer_lg: Tosuubirwa era tokkirizibwa kwewandiisa ku VAT; okwewandiisa ku VAT kukozesebwa bokka abakola emirimu egisasulwako omusolo ogwa bulijjo oba egya zero-rated.
question_sw: Nini kinatokea ikiwa ninajihusisha na bidhaa zilizosamehewa pekee?
answer_sw: Hutarajiwi wala kuruhusiwa kujisajili kwa VAT; usajili wa VAT unatumika tu kwa watu wanaotoa bidhaa za kiwango cha kawaida au za zero-rated.

question: Can an unregistered business charge VAT on its invoices?
answer: No. Under the Value Added Tax Act, only a VAT-registered business can charge VAT or issue tax invoices. An unregistered business cannot charge VAT; doing so is an offence liable to penal tax and prosecution under the Tax Procedures Code Act.
question_lg: Bizinensi etawandiisibwa esobola okuggyako omusolo gwa VAT ku invoisi zaayo?
answer_lg: Nedda. Wansi w'etteeka lya Value Added Tax Act, bizinensi eyawandiisibwa ku VAT yokka y'esobola okuggyako VAT oba okufulumya tax invoice. Bizinensi etawandiisibwa tesobola kuggyako VAT; okukikola musango oguvunaanibwa wansi w'etteeka lya Tax Procedures Code Act.
question_sw: Je, biashara ambayo haijasajiliwa inaweza kutoza VAT kwenye ankara zake?
answer_sw: Hapana. Chini ya Sheria ya VAT, biashara iliyosajiliwa kwa VAT pekee ndiyo inayoweza kutoza VAT au kutoa ankara za kodi. Biashara ambayo haijasajiliwa haiwezi kutoza VAT; kufanya hivyo ni kosa linalotozwa faini na mashtaka chini ya Sheria ya Kanuni za Taratibu za Kodi.

question: What are the statutory VAT registration thresholds in Uganda?
answer: Under Section 7 of the Value Added Tax Act and URA guidelines at https://ura.go.ug/en/value-added-tax-vat/: 1) The compulsory annual registration threshold is UGX 300,000,000 in any twelve-month period; 2) The quarterly threshold is UGX 75,000,000 in any three consecutive calendar months; 3) If taxable turnover exceeds UGX 75,000,000 in three months, the taxpayer must apply within 20 days after the end of that period; 4) If turnover is expected to exceed UGX 75,000,000 in the upcoming quarter, application must be made at the beginning of the period; 5) Public authorities engaging in business must register irrespective of turnover.
question_lg: Kkomo ki ez'amateeka ez'okwewandiisa ku VAT mu Uganda?
answer_lg: Wansi w'Ekitundu 7 (Section 7) eky'etteeka lya Value Added Tax Act: 1) Ekkomo ly'omwaka ery'okuwandiisibwa ku buwaze liri UGX 300,000,000 mu bbanga ly'emyezi 12; 2) Ekkomo ly'emyezi esatu (quarter) liri UGX 75,000,000 mu myezi esatu egy'omuddiringanwa; 3) Singa ssente ezikunganyiziddwa zisukka UGX 75,000,000 mu myezi esatu, omusasuzi w'omusolo alina okusaba mu nnaku 20 oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera ekyo okuggwako; 4) Singa zisuubirwa okusukka UGX 75,000,000 mu myezi esatu egijja, okusaba kulina okukolebwa ku ntandikwa y'ekiseera ekyo; 5) Ebitongole bya gavumenti ebyenyigira mu busuubuzi birina okwewandiisa wadde nga tebinnatuuka ku kkomo eyo.
question_sw: Ni viwango gani vya kisheria vya usajili wa VAT nchini Uganda?
answer_sw: Chini ya Kifungu cha 7 (Section 7) cha Sheria ya VAT: 1) Kiwango cha lazima cha kila mwaka cha usajili ni UGX 300,000,000 katika kipindi cha miezi 12; 2) Kiwango cha robo mwaka ni UGX 75,000,000 katika miezi mitatu mfululizo; 3) Ikiwa mauzo yanayotozwa kodi yatazidi UGX 75,000,000 katika miezi mitatu, mlipakodi lazima aombe ndani ya siku 20 baada ya mwisho wa kipindi hicho; 4) Ikiwa mauzo yanatarajiwa kuzidi UGX 75,000,000 katika robo inayokuja, maombi lazima yafanywe mwanzoni mwa kipindi; 5) Mamlaka za umma zinazofanya biashara lazima zijisajili bila kujali mauzo.

question: How does EFRIS calculate input VAT, output VAT, and net VAT payable?
answer: In EFRIS, if a trader purchases goods worth UGX 1,000 (excl. VAT) from a VAT-registered supplier, 18% VAT (UGX 180) is charged as input tax credit. When the trader sells the goods at UGX 1,500 (excl. VAT), 18% VAT (UGX 270) is charged as output tax. The net VAT remitted to URA is Output VAT (UGX 270) minus Input VAT (UGX 180) = UGX 90.
question_lg: EFRIS ebalirira etya input VAT, output VAT, ne net VAT erina okusasulwa?
answer_lg: Mu EFRIS, singa omusuubuzi agula ebintu eby'omuwendo gwa UGX 1,000 (ng'oggyeko VAT) okuva ku musuubuzi eyawandiisibwa ku VAT, 18% eya VAT (UGX 180) eggyibwako nga input tax credit. Omusuubuzi bw'atunda ebintu ebyo ku UGX 1,500 (ng'oggyeko VAT), 18% eya VAT (UGX 270) eggyibwako nga output tax. Net VAT esasulwa eri URA eba Output VAT (UGX 270) ng'oggyeko Input VAT (UGX 180) = UGX 90.
question_sw: Jinsi gani EFRIS inavyokokotoa input VAT, output VAT, na jumla ya VAT inayolipwa?
answer_sw: Katika EFRIS, ikiwa mfanyabiashara ananunua bidhaa za thamani ya UGX 1,000 (bila VAT) kutoka kwa msambazaji aliyesajiliwa na VAT, 18% ya VAT (UGX 180) inatozwa kama mkopo wa kodi ya pembejeo (input tax credit). Mfanyabiashara anapouza bidhaa hizo kwa UGX 1,500 (bila VAT), 18% ya VAT (UGX 270) inatozwa kama kodi ya kutoa (output tax). Jumla ya VAT inayowasilishwa kwa URA ni Output VAT (UGX 270) kutoa Input VAT (UGX 180) = UGX 90.

question: What are the statutory penalties for VAT non-compliance?
answer: Under the Value Added Tax Act: 1) Failure to apply for registration: Double the amount of tax payable during the period until registered; 2) Late filing of VAT return: The greater of UGX 200,000 or interest at 2% compounded per month; 3) Late payment of VAT: Interest at 2% compounded per month on the unpaid balance; 4) Failure to maintain proper records: Double the tax payable for the period; 5) False or misleading statement or omission: Double the excess tax, refund, or claim.
question_lg: Bubonerezo ki obw'amateeka obubaawo olw'obutagondera mateeka ga VAT?
answer_lg: Wansi w'etteeka lya Value Added Tax Act: 1) Obutasaba kwewandiisa: Emirundi ebiri egy'omusolo ogwandisasuddwa mu kiseera ekyo okutuusa lw'owandiisibwa; 2) Okukerewa okuwaayo return ya VAT: Esinga obunene wakati wa UGX 200,000 oba amagoba ga 2% buli mwezi; 3) Okukerewa okusasula VAT: Amagoba ga 2% buli mwezi ku ssente ezitasasuddwa; 4) Obutakuuma biwandiiko bituufu: Emirundi ebiri egy'omusolo oguteekwa okusasulwa mu kiseera ekyo; 5) Ebiwandiiko ebikyamu oba ebibuzaabuuza: Emirundi ebiri egy'omusolo ogusukkiridde, ogw'okuddizibwa oba ogusabiddwa.
question_sw: Je, ni adhabu zipi za kisheria kwa kutotii sheria za VAT?
answer_sw: Chini ya Sheria ya VAT: 1) Kushindwa kuomba usajili: Mara mbili ya kiasi cha kodi inayolipwa katika kipindi hicho hadi usajiliwe; 2) Kuchelewa kuwasilisha ritani ya VAT: Kiasi kikubwa kati ya UGX 200,000 au riba ya 2% kwa mwezi; 3) Kuchelewa kulipa VAT: Riba ya 2% kwa mwezi kwa salio ambalo halijalipwa; 4) Kushindwa kutunza kumbukumbu sahihi: Mara mbili ya kodi inayolipwa kwa kipindi hicho; 5) Taarifa za uwongo au za kupotosha: Mara mbili ya kodi ya ziada, urejeshaji, au madai.

question_lg: Nsobola kuggya wa ekitabo ekikulu ekya URA eky'omusolo gwa VAT?
answer_lg: Akatabo ak'obutongole aka 'Value Added Tax (VAT)' (FY 2026-27, empapula 4) kaliko ku mukutu gwa https://ura.go.ug/storage/2026/09/VALUE-ADDED-TAX-FY-2026-27ENG-1.pdf era kazaalibwa wansi wa Domestic Taxes ku https://ura.go.ug/en/value-added-tax-vat/ ne https://ura.go.ug/en/category/tax-education/general-tax-information/value-added-tax-vat/ (yawandiikibwa Esther Watsemwa, July 24, 2024).

answer_sw: Kitabu rasmi cha 'Value Added Tax (VAT)' (FY 2026-27, kurasa 4) kinaweza kupakuliwa katika https://ura.go.ug/storage/2026/09/VALUE-ADDED-TAX-FY-2026-27ENG-1.pdf na kuchapishwa chini ya Kodi za Ndani kwenye https://ura.go.ug/en/value-added-tax-vat/ na https://ura.go.ug/en/category/tax-education/general-tax-information/value-added-tax-vat/ (iliyoandikwa na Esther Watsemwa, Julai 24, 2024).
